newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Bank's stock keeps Mauritius bourse index stable.
newsitem.headline: Bank's stock keeps Mauritius bourse index stable.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius index, Semdex, gained 1.03 points on Wednesday to 381.86, after rising shares on bank's stock kept the market stable, bourse officials said.
Turnover amounted to 5.75 million rupees on 160,810 shares from 15.70 million rupees on 249,409 shares on Monday.
"The Semdex has been declining for six consecutive trading sessions in June and earlier July; now it's high time that the stock market knows a certain stability," one broker said.
State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) edged up 30 cents to 12.30 rupees on 17,900 shares but Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) eased 50 cents to 90.00 rupees on 19,409 shares.

In the hotel sector, Sun Resorts remained unchanged to 50.00 rupees on 310 shares, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) gained 40 cents to 37.60 rupees, but was not quoted and Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) climbed 10 cents to 49.10 rupees and unquoted.

Commerce conglomerates Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) was down by 20 cents to 15.80 rupees on 230 shares and Rogers remained unchanged to 96.00 rupees on 90 shares. Happy World Foods (HWF) was stable at 15.30 rupees on 6,600 shares.
In the investment sector, National Investment Trust (NIT) rose 20 cents to 10.20 rupees on 14,040 shares and United Docks was unchanged to 36.00 rupees on 65,223 shares.
"There was a cross trade (put through) on United Docks shares," said another broker.
Sugar-based Mon Desert Alma (MDA) (O) remained 85.00 rupees on 1,111 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) was stable at 39.50 rupees to 250 shares.
National carrier Air Mauritius remained unchanged to 37.30 rupees on 14,360 shares.
